aboutHeading: A local owner looking after local homes
aboutText:
Phinney Properties is run by Nancy Phinney, a lifelong Minnesota resident with more than 26 years in the business.

We own and manage our own rental homes in Edina, along with a vacation home in Destin, Florida that guests rate 9.8 out of 10 across more than 100 reviews. Your rental gets the same care we give ours.
